capabilities: Display frontmatter titles instead of filenames in the file explorer, search, quick switcher, bookmarks and backlinks
Show titles in tabs, note headers, inline title, window frame, graph and canvas
Rewrite wiki link text to the note's title
Configure which frontmatter key supplies the title via templates
Fall back to the original filename when the title key is missing or empty
disambiguation: Does not rename files or write titles; it only changes what Obsidian displays, leaving filenames on disk untouched.
extras: Provides an API provider so other plugins can integrate with the displayed titles; fuller feature list with screenshots lives in separate docs pages, and donations are accepted via Buy me a Coffee.
intentEvidence: shows a friendly title from your note's frontmatter everywhere in the app — without renaming the file
problem: Obsidian shows filenames everywhere, which is confusing when notes are named with timestamps, random IDs, or other non-readable schemes.

relations.evidence: Install via the BRAT plugin and point it at this repository.

summary: Displays a title read from each note's frontmatter in place of its filename across the Obsidian UI, without renaming any files.
